newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Paranagua bulk sugar shipments race ahead of 1995.
newsitem.headline: Paranagua bulk sugar shipments race ahead of 1995.

text.p: Bulk sugar shipments from Brazil's port of Paranagua are now almost double that exported in the whole of 1995, according to figures from the port authority.
As of September 25, some 292,547 tonnes of bulk sugar had left the port against 88,232 tonnes to the same date last year and 155,051 tonnes in the whole of 1995.
Bulk sugar shipments so far this month from Paranagua totalled 105,344 tonnes, well up from the 32,794 tonnes in the corresponding period last year.

Bagged sugar exports were also running higher than last year at 275,715 tonnes against 247,668 tonnes to September 25, 1995. Bagged sugar shipments were 337,734 tonnes throughout the 12 months of 1995.
Some 76,541 tonnes of bagged sugar had been loaded so far this month against 55,126 tonnes to the same stage in September last year, the port authority said.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
